operator_work.limitation: Generic OLS telemetry does not expose full matvec/projector counts. Iterations are not promoted to operator counts. Bread and raw-residual costs share one timer; packed score-cache construction can be included in within_norms.
operator_work.observable: Full published solver metadata/certificates recorded per completed fit and pair, including iterations, retries and fallback. Independent traces record preparation, RHS, raw moments, absorption, within norms, finite solve, bread/raw residual, residual correction, score, inference and output phases.

production_path_comparison.finding: OLS consumes the finalized prepared sample and memberships once. PPML retains topology but adds separation, weight changes and generation invalidation.
OLS keeps its CMG/LSMR and generic MAP/CG auto policy. ADR 0029 admits PPML auto LSMR only for eligible two/three-FE fast-memory fits.
OLS already sorts the largest CMG core effects; PPML retained Schwarz/multiway bridges and changing-weight CMG are separate callers.
OLS already batches outcome and controls. PPML additionally solves joint increments and repeats canonical projection checkpoints.
OLS owns one-shot fast or scratch-backed low execution; retained PPML sessions and CMG caller buffers are separate from OLS OwnedResults.
Both use bounded worker teams. OLS serial norms were fused; its prior parallel loop scanned columns separately. The retained change blocks wide scans and keeps each column row order.
Guarded OLS Cholesky/QR and retained PPML all-width rank share primitives with distinct ownership and rank policies.
Independent projection, score, bread/inverse, DoF/VCE and reconstruction checks remain. PPML also certifies strict predictor/objective and final-Hessian synchronization.
OLS already retains CMG setup across blocks and avoids certified residual correction where admitted. IRLS warm starts/checkpoint refinement do not transfer to a one-shot fit.

prototype_history.final_refinement: Worker-local scales avoid per-row writes to adjacent output chunks. Cache-line contention is a source-based mechanism, not a measured hardware-counter claim. Only the final local-stack source passes the target and guard thresholds.
